one_sentence: W3 is identically the ancestor on both faces (d=0 on every paired unit; trivial stability, not a revision). Among actual revisions, no child×face jointly has the highest sign consistency and the smallest Var(d)/Var(g): highest sign consistency is W1_hampel_filter/support_face (0.952381, mostly negative); smallest Var ratio is CAND_outlier_iqr({})>winsorize({})/delayed_face (0.143800). Var(d)<Var(g) on 8/8 non-zero pairs, so d is generally smaller in variance than g, but sign(d) is as concentrated as sign(g) on only 1/8 pairs. Descriptive only.
